output.reason: The brief backs its tag-stock explanation with natural controls: Pelion had the same crew pool and didn't get worse, the 14–16 Oct Brackwater-vs-Fennick comparison showed 1.6% vs 12.1% read failures, and bags that read automatically stayed at baseline. That fits the timing of the printer-ticket spike, and the brief ends with clear, cheap, reversible next steps.
